Colchicine was safe and ef ﬁcacious in all randomised clinical trials on adult patients for the primary and secondary prevention of pericarditis (RR¼0.40, 95% CI 0.30 to 0.54; p <0.001) without a signi ﬁcant increase of side effects compared to placebo (RR ¼1.22, 95% CI 0.71 to 2.10, p ¼0.48), but a higher risk of drug withdrawal (RR¼1.85, 95% CI 1.04 to 3.29), p ¼0.04).
